build.method: Arbor 0.12.2 was rebuilt from source with the local compiler before linking the catalogue.

resolved_blocker.detail: The installed wheel carried Apple LLVM 17 bitcode while the local linker read LLVM 16. Rebuilding Arbor 0.12.2 with the local compiler produced a loadable ABI-compatible catalogue.

scientific_status: Source equations, generated CPU kernels, catalogue loading, mechanism schema, and real two-cell Arbor behavior are validated. Full-network NEURON-Arbor equivalence remains an empirical audit result.
